Hash Tables
COMP26120 - Week 3
Hashing, collisions, load factor, resizing

Hash functions
Map a key to an array index
h(k) = k mod m
Spread keys uniformly across buckets

Collisions
Two keys can map to the same index
Separate chaining: a list per bucket
Open addressing: probe for a free slot

Load factor
α = n / m  (items / buckets)
Keep α below 0.75
Lookup is O(1) on average

Resizing
Double the array when the load factor is too high
Rehash every key
Insert is amortised O(1)
